title: 1570 Concepción earthquake
text: The 1570 Concepción earthquake occurred at 9:00, on February 8, 1570. The earthquake caused significant damage to the city of Concepción, Chile. A tsunami followed the earthquake afterwards, however the majority of the townsfolk of Concepción were able to escape inland from the tsunami. An estimated 2,000 people died in the event. Aftershocks were felt from the earthquake until 5 months afterwards.
